newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico gives first 1997 corn import permits.
newsitem.headline: Mexico gives first 1997 corn import permits.

text.p: Mexico announced a first package of corn import permits totaling 910,000 tonnes for the feed and processing industries, U.S. Feeds Grains Council said in a document obtained Friday.

"It is the first time this marketing year that the government has opened up permits for feed and dry milling use. The permits will be effective April 1-June 30," Ricardo Celma, the director of the Mexican office of the Feeds Grains Council said in the report.
Celma added that so far this year 600,000 tonnes of corn imports have been allowed for the wet milling industry.
